scope: Startup-only macOS physical metadata database replacement from an explicitly chosen valid current-schema snapshot. No live formal app or daily database operation; no Agent prompt/SDK calls, account/model/config changes, Keychain or Agent-private history access.
implementation: Candidate source main/WAL/SHM/journal are no-follow read-only captured with exact set/content checks. Private SQLite backup yields reviewed snapshot; later source-path changes do not alter the ticket.

Exact trusted current sqlite_schema objects (including constraints/index SQL) are compared, user_version/application_id must match, integrity_check must be ok, required LifeModel JSON values must parse. Unknown/future schemas rejected; no migration on source.
Recovery commands require not ready, not editable, no MetaStore. Same recovery mutex spans material work; atomic admission excludes normal close/exit and no old renderer is asked to save.

Durable Preparing intent is persisted before first exact Farfold-Restore sentinel directory. Original main/WAL/SHM/journal identities are represented by exact filenames, lengths and hashes, without arbitrary paths. Record max64KiB; current material total max512MiB.

Preparing never moves original files. Failure/restart permits explicit new preview only if originals remain exact and retained-original directory is empty; previous record and partial materials remain. Unknown/missing/malformed/symlink intent with material sentinel closes gate.

Complete protected raw copies and a separately verified candidate precede durable Prepared. Native macOS no-replace rename moves originals individually to a separate retained directory, then promotes new main; directory sync and actual identities govern continuation.
Installed state requires original retention, protected copies, new-main digest and no old sidefiles. Same process stays noneditable and requires explicit restart.

Cold startup checks intent before opening MetaStore. Installed digest/file set and private integrity/schema must revalidate, then durable Released must succeed before opening. Failed release returns error even when its record may have been written. Released never compares old digest or replays replacement; later legitimate writes remain.

GUI separates preview, explicit confirmation, prepare retry, continue, status query and restart. Unknown apply only checks status; exact prior Preparing can regain reselection, different active ticket cannot. Restart acknowledgement holds duplicate guard.

Restored semantic drafts/preparations still pass existing DraftStartup parsers. Queue restore stays stopped/uncertain; no send occurs from recovery. Template editing draft included in two-key preview count without expanding key allowlist.
